main.summary: Provides client-side working-directory storage helpers for persisted DataControl segmented transfer sessions.

field.name: Storage
field.summary: Underlying segmented transfer storage used to persist manifests, object payloads, and staged stream content beneath the working directory root.

field.name: StreamStorage
field.summary: Underlying stream transfer storage used to persist manifests, object payloads, and append-oriented stream content beneath the stream working-directory root.

constructor.name: DataControlClientWorkingDirectoryStorage
constructor.summary: Create the working-directory storage wrapper for DataControl client transfer sessions.
constructor.param: Optional working-directory settings used to resolve the local segmented transfer storage root.

property.name: RootPath
property.summary: Resolved root path where segmented transfer session data is persisted locally.

property.name: StreamRootPath
property.summary: Resolved root path where stream transfer session data is persisted locally.

field.name: UploadSourceDescriptorFileName
field.summary: File name used to persist the upload source descriptor beside the session manifest.

method.name: CreateManifest
method.summary: Create a staged transfer manifest from a persisted transfer state snapshot.
method.param: Transfer state to convert into a storage manifest.
method.returns: Normalized manifest created from the provided state.

method.name: ReplaceStreamSessionIdentity
method.summary: Rename a persisted stream session directory to a replacement session identifier and rewrite the stream manifest to the supplied replacement state.
method.param: Replacement stream transfer state whose session identifier becomes the new local identity.
method.returns: Updated local stream session metadata after the rename succeeds, or null when the local session cannot be migrated.

method.name: ReplaceStreamSessionWithSegmentedIdentity
method.summary: Replace a persisted local stream session with segmented-session artifacts for the supplied replacement segmented state, preserving the serialized object payload and any locally buffered stream bytes.
method.param: Replacement segmented transfer state whose session identifier becomes the new local segmented identity.
method.returns: Updated local segmented session metadata after the cross-family migration succeeds, or null when the local session cannot be migrated.

method.name: ReplaceSegmentedSessionIdentity
method.summary: Rename a persisted segmented session directory to a replacement session identifier and rewrite the segmented manifest to the supplied replacement state.
method.param: Replacement segmented transfer state whose session identifier becomes the new local identity.
method.returns: Updated local session metadata after the rename succeeds, or null when the local session cannot be migrated.

method.name: LoadUploadSourceDescriptor
method.summary: Load the persisted upload source descriptor stored beside a local session manifest.
method.param: True to resolve the descriptor from the stream-session root instead of the segmented-session root.
method.returns: Persisted upload source descriptor when one exists and can be parsed.

method.name: GetUploadSourceDescriptorPath
method.summary: Get the file path for the persisted upload source descriptor stored beside a local session manifest.
method.param: True to resolve the descriptor from the stream-session root instead of the segmented-session root.
method.returns: File path for the persisted upload source descriptor.

method.name: CreateStreamSession
method.summary: Create local stream session artifacts for the supplied stream transfer state and serialized object payload.
method.param: Initial stream transfer state for the session.
Serialized object payload to persist beside the stream session manifest.
method.returns: Resolved stream session paths when the session is created successfully.

method.name: OpenUploadSourceRange
method.summary: Open a readable bounded range from the persisted upload source described for a resumable finite upload session.
method.param: Persisted source descriptor that determines how the source should be reopened.
method.returns: Readable bounded stream when the described source can be reopened for the requested range.

method.name: CreateStreamManifest
method.summary: Create a stream transfer manifest from a persisted stream transfer state snapshot and serialized object payload.
method.param: Stream transfer state to convert into a storage manifest.
Serialized object payload to embed in the manifest.
method.returns: Stream manifest created from the provided state.

method.name: SaveUploadSourceDescriptor
method.summary: Persist the upload source descriptor beside the local session state so resumable uploads can reopen their source semantics after restart.
method.param: True to persist the descriptor beneath the stream-session root instead of the segmented-session root.
method.returns: True when the descriptor is written successfully.

method.name: CreateStreamSessionInfo
method.summary: Create client session metadata from a persisted stream manifest and working-directory path.
method.param: Working directory associated with the session.
Optional upload source descriptor associated with the session.
method.returns: Client-facing transfer session information.

method.name: EnumerateSegmentedSessionIDs
method.summary: Enumerate local segmented transfer session identifiers beneath the segmented working-directory root.
method.returns: Discovered segmented transfer session identifiers.

method.name: EnumerateStreamSessionIDs
method.summary: Enumerate local stream transfer session identifiers beneath the stream working-directory root.
method.returns: Discovered stream transfer session identifiers.

method.name: EnumerateSessionIDs
method.summary: Enumerate session directory names that can be parsed as GUID identifiers beneath the provided root path.
method.param: Root directory to scan for persisted session subdirectories.
method.returns: Session identifiers discovered under the provided root path.

method.name: CreateSession
method.summary: Create local staged session artifacts for the supplied transfer state and serialized object payload.
method.param: Initial transfer state for the session.
Serialized object payload to persist beside the session manifest.
method.returns: Resolved session paths when the session is created successfully.

method.name: DeleteStreamSession
method.summary: Delete all persisted local artifacts for a stream transfer session.
method.returns: True when the local stream session artifacts are deleted successfully.

method.name: CreateSessionInfo
method.summary: Create client session metadata from a persisted manifest and working-directory path.
method.param: Working directory associated with the session.
Optional upload source descriptor associated with the session.
method.returns: Client-facing transfer session information.

method.name: DeleteSession
method.summary: Delete all persisted local artifacts for a transfer session.
method.returns: True when the local session artifacts are deleted successfully.

method.name: GetSessionPaths
method.summary: Resolve the conventional local storage paths for a transfer session.
method.returns: Resolved session storage paths.

method.name: GetStreamSessionPaths
method.summary: Resolve the conventional local storage paths for a stream transfer session.
method.returns: Resolved stream session storage paths.

method.name: GetSegmentedStorageRootPath
method.summary: Resolve the effective local segmented transfer storage root path from the optional working-directory options.
method.returns: Absolute root path used for local segmented transfer session storage.

method.name: GetStreamStorageRootPath
method.summary: Resolve the effective local stream transfer storage root path from the optional working-directory options.
method.returns: Absolute root path used for local stream transfer session storage.

method.name: LoadSessionInfo
method.summary: Load persisted session metadata for a transfer session from the local working directory.
method.returns: Client-facing transfer session information when the session exists.

method.name: LoadStreamState
method.summary: Load the persisted stream transfer state for a local stream session.
method.returns: Persisted stream transfer state when the session exists.

method.name: LoadState
method.summary: Load the persisted transfer state for a local session.
method.returns: Persisted transfer state when the session exists.

method.name: ReadStreamObjectPayload
method.summary: Read the serialized object payload persisted for a local stream transfer session.
method.returns: Serialized object payload when present.

method.name: OpenPersistedRange
method.summary: Open a persisted byte range directly from the staged local stream file.
method.returns: Readable bounded stream when the staged stream file and requested range are available.

method.name: ReadStreamRange
method.summary: Read a realized payload range from the locally persisted stream transfer file through the stream storage abstraction.
method.returns: Readable stream for the requested realized stream range when available.

method.name: ReadObjectPayload
method.summary: Read the serialized object payload persisted for a local transfer session.
method.returns: Serialized object payload when present.

method.name: SaveStreamState
method.summary: Persist the latest stream transfer state for a local stream session.
method.param: Optional serialized object payload to include in the persisted stream manifest.
method.returns: True when the stream state is saved successfully.

method.name: ReadRange
method.summary: Read a realized payload range from the staged local stream file through the shared storage abstraction.
method.returns: Readable stream for the requested realized range when available.

method.name: SaveSourceStream
method.summary: Persist a source payload stream as the staged stream file for a local transfer session.
method.param: Expected number of bytes to persist.
method.returns: True when the requested number of bytes is written successfully.

method.name: SaveState
method.summary: Persist the latest transfer state for a local session.
method.returns: True when the state is saved successfully.

method.name: WriteRange
method.summary: Write a segment payload range into the local staged stream file.
method.param: Readable payload stream positioned at the first byte to write.
method.returns: Detailed outcome of the staged range write.
